newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle $0.50/$1.00 higher - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle $0.50/$1.00 higher - USDA.

text.p: Compared to last Wednesday, slaughter steers and heifers slow, both classes $0.50-1.00 lower. - USDA
Slaughter Steers: High Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1350 lbs 63.50-65.50. Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 62.50-63.50.
Select 1-2 61.50-62.50. Select and Choice Holsteins 1-2 1300-1500 lbs 56.50-58.50, four potloads long haul 60.00.
Slaughter Heifers: High Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1200 lbs 63.00-64.00, two loads near 1200 lbs 65.50. Select and Choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 61.50-63.00. Select 1-2 60.50-61.50.
